name: musket_line_of_fire
description: In the mission 'Die Armada' the Spanish musketeers fight behind their own pikemen and keep firing (#194): a friend in the line does not stop the shot (ACR skips the engine's friendly-fire look 0x559a40) but absorbs the ball unharmed. With friendly fire switched on they shoot through their own lines and keep reloading.

steps.note: the armies meet; the musketeers fire from behind the pikemen
